international.title: Alexander Zverev notified of abuse lawsuit by ex-partner during ATP Finals
international.summary: Men’s world No 1 allegedly violated terms of settlement Lawyers say Zverev will ‘defend himself against lawsuit’ Alexander Zverev was officially notified of a lawsuit filed by his former partner during the middle of the season-ending ATP Finals on Wednesday. The latest legal case against the men’s world No 1 brought by the mother of the former couple’s daughter alleges that Zverev violated the terms of an out-of-court settlement between the pair after the woman accused him of assaulting her. The lawsuit brought by Brenda Patea in Germany takes issue with Zverev reportedly saying in an interview with the French sports daily L’Equipe earlier this year that “it has been proven that the accusations were false” and “my innocence has been proven”.
